findings.title: `foldKnownUsageSummaries` (Lines 30-41) sums without the clamp that `snapshot()` applies.

findings.body:
**Reject line breaks in trailer keys.**

`formatCqTrailers` checks `value` but not `key`. A key such as `"Cq-Task: pass\nCq-Status"` produces two trailer lines at Line 17. Check both tuple fields before formatting so one entry cannot create another trailer.
